# Benefit Sums

> Free calculators and guides for UK benefits in the 2026/27 year: Universal Credit with the Local Housing Allowance of all 192 rental areas of Great Britain, Pension Credit and Savings Credit, the PIP points test, Carer’s Allowance, Child Benefit and the High Income Child Benefit Charge, State Pension age and amount, Winter Fuel Payment, childcare support, and the Scottish and Northern Ireland systems. Published by Radif Partners. Every rate is read from the DWP, HMRC, Social Security Scotland, the Scottish Government or nidirect, and dated in one parameter file. Calculations run in the browser.

## Pages

- [30 Hours Free Childcare 2026/27: Who Qualifies and Deadlines](https://uk-benefits.example/en/30-hours-free-childcare/): 30 hours free childcare 2026/27 in England: children aged 9 months to 4, each parent earning £2,643.68 over 3 months, income under £100,000, term deadlines.
- [Benefit Sums and Radif Partners: Who Builds These Tools](https://uk-benefits.example/en/about/): Who publishes Benefit Sums, why it shows each Universal Credit element and your area’s rent cap, where the 2026/27 rates come from and how to report a mistake.
- [Adult Disability Payment 2026/27: Scotland’s PIP Explained](https://uk-benefits.example/en/adult-disability-payment-scotland/): Adult Disability Payment 2026/27: £76.70 or £114.60 daily living, £30.30 or £80.00 mobility, the same as PIP. Moving to Scotland ends PIP after 13 weeks.
- [Attendance Allowance 2026/27: Rates, Rules and How to Claim](https://uk-benefits.example/en/attendance-allowance/): Attendance Allowance 2026/27: £76.70 or £114.60 a week over State Pension age if you need care. Not means-tested, and it can add £86.05 to Pension Credit.
- [Bedroom Tax 2026/27: Spare Room Cut, Rules and Exemptions](https://uk-benefits.example/en/bedroom-tax/): Bedroom tax 2026/27: 14 % of eligible rent for one spare room, 25 % for two, who counts as needing a bedroom, pension age exemption and help in each nation.
- [Benefit Cap Calculator 2026/27: London and Rest of GB](https://uk-benefits.example/en/benefit-cap-calculator/): Benefit cap calculator 2026/27: £1,835 a month for families outside London, £2,110.25 inside, exemptions, the £881 earnings test and the 9-month grace period.
- [Benefit Rates 2026/27: Weekly and Monthly Amounts Table](https://uk-benefits.example/en/benefit-rates/): Benefit rates 2026/27 in one table: Universal Credit from £338.58 a month, PIP, Carer’s Allowance £86.45, State Pension £241.30 a week, 42 rates in all.
- [Benefits Calculator 2026/27: Check What Your Household Gets](https://uk-benefits.example/en/benefits-calculator/): Benefits calculator 2026/27: Universal Credit, Child Benefit, PIP, Pension Credit, Carer’s Allowance and Scottish payments in one form, from £424.90 a month.
- [Benefits in Northern Ireland 2026/27: How the System Differs](https://uk-benefits.example/en/benefits-in-northern-ireland/): Benefits in Northern Ireland 2026/27: Universal Credit paid twice a month, housing costs to the landlord, Welfare Supplementary Payments, a £423.46 weekly cap.
- [Benefits in Scotland 2026/27: Social Security Scotland Guide](https://uk-benefits.example/en/benefits-in-scotland/): Benefits in Scotland 2026/27: ADP, Carer Support Payment and Scottish Child Payment of £28.20 a week, Best Start Grants, winter payments and UC choices.
- [Benefit Increase April 2026: 3.8%, 4.8%, What Stayed Frozen](https://uk-benefits.example/en/benefits-uprating/): Benefit increase April 2026: most benefits up 3.8%, the State Pension 4.8% to £241.30, UC standard allowance to £424.90; the benefit cap and LHA frozen.
- [Bereavement Support Payment 2026/27: Rates and Time Limits](https://uk-benefits.example/en/bereavement-support-payment/): Bereavement Support Payment 2026/27: higher rate £3,500 plus 18 monthly payments of £350, standard £2,500 plus £100 a month. Claim within 3 months for it all.
- [Best Start Grant 2026/27: Three Payments and When to Apply](https://uk-benefits.example/en/best-start-grant/): Best Start Grant 2026/27 in Scotland: Pregnancy and Baby Payment £796.65, Early Learning and School Age Payments £331.95, plus Best Start Foods rates.
- [Budgeting Loan 2026/27: Up to £812, or a Budgeting Advance](https://uk-benefits.example/en/budgeting-loan/): Budgeting Loan 2026/27: borrow £100 to £812 interest free after 6 months on Pension Credit or legacy benefits; on Universal Credit, a Budgeting Advance instead.
- [Carer Support Payment 2026/27: Scotland’s Carer Package](https://uk-benefits.example/en/carer-support-payment-scotland/): Carer Support Payment 2026/27: £86.45 a week in Scotland, plus £11.70 Scottish Carer Supplement and £10.40 for each extra person you care for, paid together.
- [Carer’s Allowance and State Pension 2026/27: The Overlap](https://uk-benefits.example/en/carers-allowance-and-state-pension/): Carer’s Allowance and State Pension 2026/27: a pension of £86.45 or more stops the payment, but the claim can still add £48.15 a week to Pension Credit.
- [Carer’s Allowance and Universal Credit 2026/27: Net Effect](https://uk-benefits.example/en/carers-allowance-and-universal-credit/): Carer’s Allowance and Universal Credit 2026/27: £86.45 a week comes off UC in full, the £209.34 carer element stays. Here is when claiming both pays off.
- [Carer’s Allowance Calculator 2026/27: The £204 Earnings Test](https://uk-benefits.example/en/carers-allowance-calculator/): Carer’s Allowance calculator 2026/27: check the £204 weekly earnings limit after tax, NI, half your pension contributions and care costs, then the £86.45 paid.
- [Carer’s Allowance 2026/27: Rate, Rules and Other Benefits](https://uk-benefits.example/en/carers-allowance/): Carer’s Allowance 2026/27: £86.45 a week if you care 35 hours for someone on a disability benefit and earn £204 or less. Rules, tax, NI credits, side effects.
- [Carer’s Credit 2026/27: NI Credits for 20 Hours of Care](https://uk-benefits.example/en/carers-credit/): Carer’s Credit 2026/27: NI credits if you care 20 hours a week for someone on a disability benefit. Each year can add £6.89 a week to your State Pension.
- [Child Benefit Calculator 2026/27: What You Keep After Tax](https://uk-benefits.example/en/child-benefit-calculator/): Child Benefit calculator 2026/27: £27.05 a week for the eldest child, £17.90 for each other child, minus the tax charge when one income tops £60,000 a year.
- [Child Benefit Rates 2026/27: Eldest and Other Children](https://uk-benefits.example/en/child-benefit-rates/): Child Benefit rates 2026/27: £27.05 a week for the eldest child and £17.90 for each other child, against 2025/26, plus payment days, backdating, split families.
- [Cold Weather Payment 2026/27: £25 a Week, Who Qualifies](https://uk-benefits.example/en/cold-weather-payment/): Cold Weather Payment 2026/27: £25 for each 7 days at or below 0°C between 1 November 2026 and 31 March 2027, paid with Pension Credit and some UC claims.
- [Cost of Living Payment 2026: None Planned, What Replaced It](https://uk-benefits.example/en/cost-of-living-payment/): Cost of Living Payment 2026: DWP plans no more after the £299 of 2024. Now: the Crisis and Resilience Fund, Winter Fuel Payment and a £150 Warm Home Discount.
- [DLA for Children 2026/27: Rates, Age Limits and Claiming](https://uk-benefits.example/en/dla-for-children/): DLA for children 2026/27: care component £30.30 to £114.60, mobility £30.30 from age 5 or £80.00 from age 3. Up to £194.60 a week, tax-free, not means-tested.
- [Free School Meals 2026/27: Universal Credit Rules by Nation](https://uk-benefits.example/en/free-school-meals/): Free school meals 2026/27: every Universal Credit child in England, the £7,400 limit gone; Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland rules and limits compared.
- [Guardian’s Allowance 2026/27: Weekly Rate and Who Qualifies](https://uk-benefits.example/en/guardians-allowance/): Guardian’s Allowance 2026/27: £22.95 a week per child, tax-free, on top of Child Benefit, for bringing up a child whose parents have died, and how to claim.
- [High Income Child Benefit Charge 2026/27: £60,000 to £80,000](https://uk-benefits.example/en/high-income-child-benefit-charge/): High Income Child Benefit Charge 2026/27: 1% of Child Benefit for every £200 of adjusted net income over £60,000, plus opting out, pensions and Gift Aid.
- [Housing Benefit Calculator 2026/27: Pension-Age Tenants](https://uk-benefits.example/en/housing-benefit-calculator/): Housing Benefit calculator 2026/27 for tenants over State Pension age: eligible rent less 65% of income above £238.00 a week, or full rent on Guarantee Credit.
- [Housing Benefit 2026/27: Who Can Claim and How Much](https://uk-benefits.example/en/housing-benefit/): Housing Benefit 2026/27: new claims at State Pension age or in supported housing, rent capped by the LHA, non-dependant deductions from £20.40 a week each.
- [Benefits Calculator UK 2026/27: UC, PIP, Pension Credit](https://uk-benefits.example/en/): Benefits calculator UK 2026/27: Universal Credit from £424.90 a month with your area's rent cap, Pension Credit, PIP points, Carer's Allowance, Child Benefit.
- [Local Housing Allowance Rates 2026/27: All 192 Areas](https://uk-benefits.example/en/local-housing-allowance-rates/): Local Housing Allowance rates 2026/27 for all 192 areas of England, Scotland and Wales, monthly: 2-bedroom from £400 to £1,794, frozen since April 2024.
- [Maternity Allowance 2026/27: Weekly Rate, Test and Claim](https://uk-benefits.example/en/maternity-allowance/): Maternity Allowance 2026/27: £194.32 a week or 90% of average pay for up to 39 weeks, the 26-in-66-week test, the self-employed £27 rate and Universal Credit.
- [Benefit Calculations 2026/27: Method, Sources and Limits](https://uk-benefits.example/en/method/): How Benefit Sums works out Universal Credit, Pension Credit, PIP, Carer’s Allowance and Child Benefit for 2026/27: the rule behind each step, what is left out.
- [New Style ESA 2026/27: Rates, Groups and Universal Credit](https://uk-benefits.example/en/new-style-esa/): New Style ESA 2026/27: £75.65 or £95.55 a week while assessed, then £95.55 in the work-related activity group or £145.90 in the support group, paid fortnightly.
- [Basic State Pension 2026/27: £184.90, Spouse Rate and Age 80](https://uk-benefits.example/en/old-basic-state-pension/): Basic State Pension 2026/27: £184.90 a week in full, £110.75 on a spouse’s record or over 80 without contributions, plus the 25p age addition and payment days.
- [Pension Age Winter Heating Payment 2026/27: Scotland Amounts](https://uk-benefits.example/en/pension-age-winter-heating-payment/): Pension Age Winter Heating Payment 2026/27 in Scotland: £105.55 to £316.70 if born on or before 27 June 1960, paid from November, recovered above £35,000.
- [Pension Credit Calculator 2026/27: Guarantee and Savings](https://uk-benefits.example/en/pension-credit-calculator/): Pension Credit calculator 2026/27: income topped up to £238.00 a week (couple £363.25), extra for disability, carers and children, plus Savings Credit.
- [Savings Credit 2026/27: Formula, Thresholds, Who Can Get It](https://uk-benefits.example/en/pension-credit-savings-credit/): Savings Credit 2026/27: up to £17.96 a week single or £20.10 for a couple, for those over State Pension age before April 2016. The 60% and 40% formula.
- [Pension Credit 2026/27: Who Qualifies and What It Unlocks](https://uk-benefits.example/en/pension-credit/): Pension Credit 2026/27 tops income up to £238.00 a week single, £363.25 for a couple. Who qualifies, what counts, backdating, and the help it unlocks.
- [PIP Eligibility 2026/27: Age, Time Test and Residence Rules](https://uk-benefits.example/en/pip-eligibility/): PIP eligibility 2026/27: aged 16 to State Pension age, difficulties for 3 months and expected for 9 more, 104 of the last 156 weeks spent in Great Britain.
- [PIP Payment Dates 2026/27: Your Next Paydays and Holidays](https://uk-benefits.example/en/pip-payment-dates/): PIP payment dates 2026/27: paid every 4 weeks in arrears on the same weekday, and a little earlier when payday is a bank holiday. Up to £778.40 per payment.
- [PIP Points Calculator 2026/27: Score All 12 Activities](https://uk-benefits.example/en/pip-points-calculator/): PIP points calculator 2026/27: choose a descriptor for each of the 12 activities. 8 points gives the standard rate, 12 the enhanced, up to £194.60 a week.
- [PIP Rates 2026/27: Weekly, 4-Weekly and Yearly Amounts](https://uk-benefits.example/en/pip-rates/): PIP rates 2026/27: daily living £76.70 or £114.60 a week, mobility £30.30 or £80.00. All nine combinations, weekly, every 4 weeks and per year, in a table.
- [Scottish Child Payment 2026/27: £28.20 a Week per Child](https://uk-benefits.example/en/scottish-child-payment/): Scottish Child Payment 2026/27: £28.20 a week for each child under 16, paid every 4 weeks to Scottish families on Universal Credit and other benefits.
- [State Pension Age Calculator 2026: The Rise from 66 to 67](https://uk-benefits.example/en/state-pension-age-calculator/): State Pension age calculator 2026: your exact date from your birthday, with the month-by-month rise from 66 to 67 for those born from 6 April 1960, then 68.
- [State Pension Amount 2026/27: £241.30 a Week and Your Years](https://uk-benefits.example/en/state-pension-amount/): State Pension amount 2026/27: the full new State Pension is £241.30 a week. See what your qualifying years give (1/35 each, from 10) and what deferring adds.
- [State Pension Deferral 2026/27: 1% Every 9 Weeks Explained](https://uk-benefits.example/en/state-pension-deferral/): State Pension deferral 2026/27: 1% extra for every 9 weeks, about £13.94 a week after a year on the full £241.30, or arrears of up to 52 weeks as a lump sum.
- [Sure Start Maternity Grant 2026/27: £500, Who Can Claim](https://uk-benefits.example/en/sure-start-maternity-grant/): Sure Start Maternity Grant 2026/27: a one-off £500 for a first baby or twins on Universal Credit or Pension Credit, claimed from 11 weeks before the due week.
- [Tax-Free Childcare Calculator 2026/27: Government Top-Up](https://uk-benefits.example/en/tax-free-childcare-calculator/): Tax-Free Childcare calculator 2026/27: the government adds £2 for every £8 you pay in, up to £500 a quarter for each child, or £1,000 for a disabled child.
- [Universal Credit and PIP 2026/27: How the Two Fit Together](https://uk-benefits.example/en/universal-credit-and-pip/): Universal Credit and PIP 2026/27: PIP of up to £194.60 a week is not taken off Universal Credit, lifts the benefit cap and stops the £96.55 deduction.
- [Universal Credit Calculator 2026/27: Monthly Award by Area](https://uk-benefits.example/en/universal-credit-calculator/): Universal Credit calculator 2026/27: standard allowance, child, health, carer and childcare elements, rent capped by your area’s LHA, then the 55% taper.
- [Universal Credit Carer Element 2026/27: Who Gets £209.34](https://uk-benefits.example/en/universal-credit-carer-element/): Universal Credit carer element 2026/27: £209.34 a month for 35 hours of care a week for someone on PIP, AA, DLA or ADP. No earnings limit; not paid with LCWRA.
- [Universal Credit Childcare Costs 2026/27: 85 % Paid Back](https://uk-benefits.example/en/universal-credit-childcare-costs/): Universal Credit childcare costs 2026/27: 85 % of registered childcare refunded, up to £1,071.09 a month for one child or £1,836.16 for two or more children.
- [Universal Credit Deductions 2026/27: 15 % Cap and Sanctions](https://uk-benefits.example/en/universal-credit-deductions/): Universal Credit deductions 2026/27: at most 15 % of the standard allowance, £63.74 a month for a single person 25+. Third-party, rent arrears, sanctions.
- [Universal Credit Health Element 2026/27: Two LCWRA Rates](https://uk-benefits.example/en/universal-credit-health-element/): Universal Credit health element 2026/27: LCWRA pays £429.80 or, for most new claims since 6 April 2026, £217.26 a month. Severe conditions and the WCA.
- [Universal Credit Housing Element 2026/27: Rent Help Rules](https://uk-benefits.example/en/universal-credit-housing-element/): Universal Credit housing element 2026/27: private rent capped at your area’s LHA, social rent cut 14 % or 25 % for spare rooms, £96.55 per non-dependant.
- [Universal Credit Payment Dates 2026/27: When Money Arrives](https://uk-benefits.example/en/universal-credit-payment-dates/): Universal Credit payment dates 2026/27: paid 7 days after each monthly assessment period ends, first payment about 5 weeks after claiming. Bank holiday dates.
- [Universal Credit Rates 2026/27: Every Monthly Amount](https://uk-benefits.example/en/universal-credit-rates/): Universal Credit rates 2026/27: standard allowance £424.90 at 25 or over, £303.94 per child, health, carer and childcare amounts, each beside 2025/26.
- [Universal Credit Savings 2026/27: £6,000 and £16,000 Limits](https://uk-benefits.example/en/universal-credit-savings/): Universal Credit savings 2026/27: nothing changes below £6,000, £4.35 a month off per £250 or part above it, no award over £16,000. What counts as capital.
- [Universal Credit Two-Child Limit 2026: What Ended in April](https://uk-benefits.example/en/universal-credit-two-child-limit/): Universal Credit two-child limit ended 6 April 2026: £303.94 a month now paid for a third and later child, from May or June. Benefit cap still applies.
- [Universal Credit Under 25 2026/27: The Lower Standard Rate](https://uk-benefits.example/en/universal-credit-under-25/): Universal Credit under 25 in 2026/27: £338.58 a month if single, £528.34 for a couple both under 25. Who can claim at 16 or 17 and what else the age changes.
- [Universal Credit Work Allowance 2026/27: How Wages Count](https://uk-benefits.example/en/universal-credit-work-allowance/): Universal Credit work allowance 2026/27: £427 or £710 a month of pay ignored, then 55 % of the rest taken off. Who qualifies, with three worked payslips.
- [Winter Fuel Payment 2026/27: £200 or £300, £35,000 Rule](https://uk-benefits.example/en/winter-fuel-payment/): Winter Fuel Payment 2026/27: £200 or £300 if born on or before 27 June 1960, less in shared homes; paid automatically, recovered by HMRC above £35,000.
